name: Self Exaltation
overview: Scripture reveals self exaltation as a sinful pride where individuals arrogantly elevate themselves above God and others, as seen in Pharaoh's defiance against God's people (Exodus 9:17) and the rebellion of Korah and his associates (Numbers 16:1). The prince of Tyre exemplifies this by claiming divinity and sitting in God's seat, despite being merely a man (Ezekiel 28:2, 9). Likewise, the imagery of lifting oneself up in height symbolizes pride that leads to downfall (Ezekiel 31:10). These passages warn against the danger of self-exaltation, emphasizing God's sovereignty over all human pride.
